messages:
lenora: Noticed a spike of SCIM 403s and OIDC introspect 401s after the maintenance window. Affected tenants on EU region. Anyone on it?

samir: I started digging. SCIM logs show KMS decrypt failures when unwrapping the provisioner token envelope. Example: 
```
ERROR scim: envelope unwrap failed: kms:Decrypt failed: permission denied for cryptoKeyVersion projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeyVersions/5
tenant=beta-inc request_id=tx-77
```
Looks like key version 5 is new and SA doesn't have useToDecrypt.

kai: OIDC introspection is returning 401 for the same tenants. My trace indicates the token verifier tried to fetch the introspect secret but got a decryption error from secrets-service which itself uses the same KMS key. So two subsystems rely on that key.

alice: Can you paste the IAM diff around the maintenance window? I want to confirm if a policy change removed the role.

samir: Policy change rolled at 02:18 UTC. CloudKMS audit shows a DENY for serviceAccount:provisioner@redwood-infra in a 60s window. Also found a concurrent terraform apply that rotated default key alias from scim-key -> scim-key-v2. Probably a timing issue where alias moved before roles were applied to the new key version.

lenora: Timeline makes sense. Impact: SCIM retries hit customer rate limits and OIDC introspection clients see invalid token errors => user flows broken (login ok but certain calls fail). Immediate mitigation ideas?

kai: Short term: grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to the service accounts on the new key version. Command: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/identity/cryptoKeys/scim-key --member='serviceAccount:provisioner@redwood-infra' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```
Then rewrap all envelopes to the key version we control.

samir: We should also check if any tokens were reissued plaintext anywhere during the window. Grepped logs; only saw envelope IDs, not plaintext. Still treat as potential exposure and rotate tokens.

alice: I'll open a vuln-triage ticket with timeline, affected tenants list, and notify CS to prepare outbound comms. Suggest we push a short KB for customers: "If you saw 401s for introspection, retry after 15m".

ops-bot: terraform:apply started by infra-automation (plan id: tf-987). Changed resource: google_kms_crypto_key.scim-key alias -> v2.

lenora: Good call on rewrap. Can we script a coordinated rewrap + token rotation with zero-downtime? Notes: 1) add IAM allow to new key version, 2) start rewrap background job that decrypts envelope with old key and re-encrypts to new version, 3) rotate service tokens in batches to avoid auth storms.

kai: I'll write the rewrap job. Need to ensure we capture envelope metadata so we can replay if partial. Also add a deploy-time guard in our rollout check: do not flip alias until IAM policies exist on target key.

samir: Post-mitigation status: after adding the IAM binding, SCIM 200s resumed and OIDC introspect returns 200 on canary tenants. No token payloads found in logs. Recording all KMS audit entries in the ticket.

alice: For SSO/SAML customers we saw session termination oddities separately: some IdPs sent LogoutRequest with RelayState that our SP didn't match (relay mismatch => session persisted). I suspect an auth-proxy config drift during the maintenance (cookie domain change). Jordan on-call did a quick rollback earlier and that fixed the logout behaviour. We should add pairwise testing for logout flows in the maintenance playbook.

lenora: Agreed. Follow-ups: kai -> rewrap job + runbook, samir -> KMS IAM audit + granular postmortem timeline, alice -> vuln ticket & CS comms, lenora -> update maintenance checklist to include KMS alias gating and SSO logout canary.

ops-bot: incident:created id=INC-2026-1123 severity=high owners=[lenora,samir,kai]

lenora: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m post-incident sync after the canary completes. Leaving notes in the ticket about potential remediation: avoid alias swap without role propagation, add infra-level preflight to verify key bindings, and add a short delay between key rotation and alias flip. :lock:
